summary: Baidu Scholar for project creation and seed search (unit C): the creation page sends the ticked paper languages with each candidate search; with Baidu on, a key saved, 中文 ticked and Chinese characters in the phrase, Baidu candidates are merged with OpenAlex's (one paper per DOI); Chinese titles typed in the seed box are searched at Baidu too, hits are ranked with OpenAlex's and can be added as seeds; a Baidu problem is one short fixed status and never breaks the page.
scope_note: Worktree baidu-scholar, unit C on top of unit B (8f2c73a). New outbound data only when the user switched Baidu on (quoted owner approvals in ADR 0039; owner_approved stays false).

budget_impact.rationale: No model call or token. At most one Baidu request per creation search phrase (up to 3 per preview) and one per seed-box search, only with Baidu on and a key, counted in the shared local cap of 40 a day and answered from a 24 h cache when repeated.
budget_impact.before: creation candidates and the seed search asked OpenAlex only
budget_impact.after: same model cost (zero); one extra Baidu request per Chinese search when Baidu is on

open_risks: Baidu's response shape, page size and ranking are UNVERIFIED; how many useful Chinese candidates it returns is unmeasured.
Seed hits without a DOI exist only in server memory until the project is created; after an app restart they must be searched for again.
The creation page and seed box were tested with Node virtual pages only, not in a browser.
Independent review not done by the implementing agent.
